name: Swisscom
notes: The main Swisscom Login supports passkeys as a passwordless sign-in (My Swisscom > Profile > Login & Security). Swisscom's help positions the passkey itself as two-factor (device key + biometric/PIN) rather than offering it as a separate second factor, so passkey_mfa stays false. Not to be confused with Swisscom Trust Services (e-signature), which has its own separate login and passkey docs. Bluewin webmail (bluewin.ch) signs in with the Swisscom Login, so it is covered as an additional domain; note IMAP/mail-client access uses a separate Bluewin email password with no passkey — passkeys cover the web login only. Submitted via community issues #13 and #14.
